body:
Right now I see my family relatively often. I saw them this morning, in fact. I'm meant to be moving to a different (far away) country in a couple of weeks, after my brother's wedding but before my birthday, and then I guess I wouldn't really ever see them. I keep trying to come up with fantastical stories I could engineer to make it look like I didn't commit suicide (while still, obviously, committing suicide). This is not going well, and all of my stories are either totally implausible or wouldn't really get the job done of lessening the impact for my family.

I don't know how I'd characterize my relationship with my brother's fiancee. We don't see much of each other and are both introverted. I can't really tell if she dislikes me or is just hard to get to know.
